lines: Hebiko was the first to jump into battle.
She bounced with her powerful octopus tentacles and leaped out in front of the Taimanin.
Hebiko was holding ninja kodachi in both of her human hands and her two octopus tentacles.
What!? Oh, it's just a big number for show. I'll block them all...
Th-The smell! And I can't see anything!!
The Four Blade Style was a complete bluff. Hebiko pretended to attack, but instead spewed pitch-black ink from her mouth.
The ink smokescreen spread as if staining the space around them, enveloping the area in darkness.
Hey!? Where are you!? Are you just blinding us to run away!?
Don't move around blindly!! Avoid friendly fire.
The Taimanin had completely lost themselves due to the unexpected development.
We're not running. Didn't I say it was going to be an easy win with Hebiko and Shikanosuke on my side?
You small fry! Are you out of your mind!?
Hey, do you know the difference between squid ink and octopus ink?
Squid ink is delicious, but we don't eat octopus ink, right? And squid ink is highly viscous, so it stays together and floats. Which makes it a tasty bait.
Octopus ink, however, is silky and spreads apart quickly. That's because its purpose is to blind enemies, making it different from squid ink.
Nobody asked for a lecture about ink!! And I mean, you can't see anything like this either!
If you aren't planning to run away, isn't this just to buy time!?
Along with a booming metallic sound, you could hear the Taimanin scream one after the other, and thenー
Silence and darkness fell over the area.
By the time the smokescreen from Hebiko's ink had dissipated,
the Taimanin of the "Righteous Fuma Faction" lay strewn across the absolutely chaotic sports ground.
I... did it? With my ability...?
Of course. I told you your Electric Jutsu is powerful. It wasn't your ability alone this time though.
First, we had created an area with Hebiko's ink smokescreen where visibility was zero. No one could see, enemy and ally alike.
And then, instead of using our eyes, we had sent out electric waves using Shikanosuke's ability to pinpoint the enemies' locations. The same principle as a submarine's sonar or radar.
Afterwards, all that had been left to do was for me to dash around and smash their heads with a hammer.
(I didn't expect it to go this well though...)
If you can control electricity, it means you can make electric waves. Depending on how you use it, your ability should become even more useful.
Shikanosuke was so moved that he was trembling while looking up at the sky.
By the way, Shikanosuke... time to get off of me.
He stepped down from my shoulders. Yes, I had been carrying Shikanosuke, who had acted as the sonar, on my shoulders the whole time.
Anyways, the plan was a huge success!! Let's keep going like this!!
Yeah! I feel like I can do it!!
